NBA DFS Rankings for Sunday, October 25 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 4 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 7:56 PM ET

Cade Cunningham (DET) ranks first on the Sunday, October 25 DraftKings main slate at 51.2 projected DraftKings points for $9,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 48.1) and Jaylen Brown (PHI, 45.6) are next.

The table ranks the top 100 of 109 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 7:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
